social_media.headline: CME Arrival Confirmed
social_media.summary: A sudden shock confirms the arrival of a coronal mass ejection. Solar wind conditions are becoming strongly enhanced and geomagnetic activity is expected to increase.

confidence.label: Observed
confidence.detail: An upstream interplanetary shock was detected at 1639 UTC Friday.

what_we_know: Rapid magnetic-field changes may occur as conditions intensify.
A Warning remains in effect for G3–G5 conditions.
Additional alerts will follow when activity first reaches G3, G4, or G5.

footer.left: Begin heightened monitoring and follow sector procedures.

visual.alt_text: Observation graphic showing the arrival of a CME-driven disturbance at Earth.
